notes.text: Homer was an ancient Greek poet who is widely credited as the author of the Iliad and the Odyssey, two epic poems that are foundational works of ancient Greek literature.
Although his life and authorship remain obscure, Homer was highly revered in ancient Greek society and is considered one of the most influential authors in history.
Homer is remembered as a writer connected with Greece.
Homer's recorded life dates place this profile around -800--750.
Homer is grouped with Literature, Arts & Culture in the People Library.
